inputs.<tmp:0>/projects/shop/.brigade/worktrees:
SCHEMA TASK
	DESC "a change delivered by one pull request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS todo|implemented
		REQUIRED
	FIELD MILESTONE @MILESTONE
	FIELD SPEC string
		REPEATABLE
		FIELD IMPL anchor
			REPEATABLE

SCHEMA MILESTONE
	DESC "the tasks planned for one request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS planned|running
		REQUIRED

MILESTONE M1
	TITLE "Empty cart"
	STATUS running

TASK S2
	TITLE "Remove an item from the cart"
	STATUS implemented

TASK S3
	TITLE "Empty the cart in one click"
	STATUS todo
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1
	SPEC "the button of src/cart/button.py, once pressed, empties the cart"
	SPEC "the emptying charges nothing"

TASK S6
	TITLE "Count the emptied carts"
	STATUS todo
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1
